summary: AliceBlue's Order Status Feed: an order open, partly filled and complete, one rejected with the RMS text, an NFO stop-loss order cancelled; symbols from the master by the broker symbol.

deviations.reason: The web's order stream sends AliceBlue's product code raw (INTRADAY, LONGTERM), not OpenAlgo's MIS, CNC, NRML (docs/prompt/order-constants.md), although its own REST order book maps the same codes (transform_data.py reverse_map_product_type). The desktop maps them as that book does; a code AliceBlue has not documented passes as it came.

notes: The desktop names OpenAlgo's product (MIS, CNC, NRML) as the web's REST order book maps AliceBlue's codes (broker/aliceblue/mapping/transform_data.py reverse_map_product_type); the web's order stream passes the code raw (audit appendix item 9).
The market socket's relay logs in too, and its frame is taken from the main socket first.
